elements.description:
Decomposition equation (rendered formula, no caption):
Δy^w_{t0,t1} = α^w(s,m)
+ [Δw(e_t0 p_t0 a_t0) + Δw(e_t1 p_t1 a_t1) + Δw(e_t1 p_t0 a_t0) + Δw(e_t0 p_t1 a_t0) + Δw(e_t0 p_t0 a_t1) + Δw(e_t1 p_t1 a_t0) + Δw(e_t1 p_t0 a_t1) + Δw(e_t0 p_t1 a_t1)]
Shapley weight formula (rendered equation, no caption): α^w(s,m) = s! (m − s − 1)! / m!, where s = number of variables other than w taken at t = t1 and m = total number of variables.
Repeated Shapley weight formula (rendered equation, no caption): α^w(s,m) = s! (m − s − 1)! / m!

Shapley value of w's contribution (rendered equations, no caption):
Δy^w_{t0,t1} =
+ ¼[Δw(e_t0 p_t0 a_t0) + Δw(e_t1 p_t1 a_t1)]
+ ½[Δw(e_t1 p_t0 a_t0) + Δw(e_t0 p_t1 a_t0) + Δw(e_t0 p_t0 a_t1) + Δw(e_t1 p_t1 a_t0) + Δw(e_t1 p_t0 a_t1) + Δw(e_t0 p_t1 a_t1)]

Analogous Shapley value expressions for e, p and a (rendered equations, no caption):
Δy^e_{t0,t1} = ¼[Δe(w_t0 p_t0 a_t0) + Δe(w_t1 p_t1 a_t1)] + ½[Δe(w_t1 p_t0 a_t0) + Δe(w_t0 p_t1 a_t0) + Δe(w_t0 p_t0 a_t1) + Δe(w_t1 p_t1 a_t0) + Δe(w_t1 p_t0 a_t1) + Δe(w_t0 p_t1 a_t1)]
Δy^p_{t0,t1} = ¼[Δp(w_t0 e_t0 a_t0) + Δp(w_t1 e_t1 a_t1)] + ½[Δp(w_t1 e_t0 a_t0) + Δp(w_t0 e_t1 a_t0) + Δp(w_t0 e_t0 a_t1) + Δp(w_t1 e_t1 a_t0) + Δp(w_t1 e_t0 a_t1) + Δp(w_t0 e_t1 a_t1)]
Δy^a_{t0,t1} = ¼[Δa(w_t0 e_t0 p_t0) + Δa(w_t1 e_t1 p_t1)] + ½[Δa(w_t1 e_t0 p_t0) + Δa(w_t0 e_t1 p_t0) + Δa(w_t0 e_t0 p_t1) + Δa(w_t1 e_t1 p_t0) + Δa(w_t1 e_t0 p_t1) + Δa(w_t0 e_t1 p_t1)]
